answer.conflict_group_limit: These are declared product-owned groups of registered style-choice IDs. They do not establish mutual exclusion for arbitrary configuration keys or specify a CLI invocation. In particular, the var choice summaries say the three csharp_style_var_* editorconfig categories are independent; the group alone cannot override that statement.

omitted_boolean_interpretation.known_choice_complete_data: For a registered member and an available Boolean map with complete coverage, absence from its property_set means false for that Boolean. For example, qualify-field-access is absent from byte_divergent and corpus_endorsed, so both are false; it is present in oracle_endorsed, so that one is true.
omitted_boolean_interpretation.unknown_id: An ID absent from a complete member list is not a registered choice here. Its Boolean values are not established, so absence must not be reported as false for that ID.
omitted_boolean_interpretation.incomplete_data: When member or Boolean coverage is incomplete, omission is unknown, not false.
omitted_boolean_interpretation.unavailable_property: When a property is unavailable, omission is unavailable, not false, regardless of an otherwise complete member list. Preserve the unavailable state in any filtered result.
